title: Quran Waqf & Ibtida Application Feed Schema
description: Production feed schema projecting raw Al-Sajawandi Waqf apparatus merged with Uthmani Mushaf pause marks and canonical Quran word tokens.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of the feed schema, e.g. '1.0.0'

surahName.description: Arabic name of the surah, e.g. 'سورة يوسف'

sourceBatch.description: List of source batch files used in this feed

sourceTag.description: Precedence tag of the extraction source

ayahs.description: Sequential ayahs containing words and word-level stop linkages

index.description: 1-based word position in this ayah (matches quran-words position p)

text.description: Display text in Uthmani script with diacritics (from quran-words clean_u)

textImlai.description: Imla'i / simple Arabic text without archaic orthography (from quran-words i)

stopId.description: ID of the associated WaqfStop if a stop is present on this word, else null

inUthmaniMushaf.description: Whether this word carries an official Uthmani mushaf pause mark glyph

uthmaniMark.description: Printed Uthmani mark symbol (صلى, قلى, ج, مـ, لا, ∴, س) or null

uthmaniMarkName.description: Descriptive rule name of the Uthmani mark (e.g. جائز, الوصل أولى, etc.)

uthmaniMarkCode.description: Canonical identifier code for the mark (e.g. JEEM, SALA, QALA, MEEM, LA, MUANAQAH, SAKTAH)

stops.description: Catalog of waqf stops with scholastic rulings, reasons, and apparatus opinions

id.description: Stable unique identifier formatted as s{surah}-a{ayah}-w{wordIndex}

word.description: Display word with diacritics from quran-words

targetWord.description: Raw target word / phrase exactly as printed in Al-Sajawandi

label.description: Display label in Arabic (e.g. تام, جائز, مجوَّز, مرخَّص, لازم, لا يوقف, قيل فيه وقف, غير محسوم)

textPage.description: Page in the printed book Ilal al-Wuquf

marginRef.description: Footnote reference number in the margin

fixes.description: Editorial fixes applied to matn text

opinions.description: Scholarly opinions. Item 1 is always Al-Sajawandi from matn, followed by margin apparatus opinions

scholar.description: Scholar name (e.g. أبو عبد الله السجاوندي, ابن الأنباري, الداني, النحاس, etc.)

verdict.description: Scholarly verdict (تام, كاف, حسن, صالح, جائز, مفهوم, لا يوقف, etc.)

verdictLabel.description: Sajawandi symbol letter if applicable, else null

book.description: Reference source work (علل الوقوف, الإيضاح, المكتفى, المنار, etc.)

page.description: Locus or page in the source work

comment.description: Commentary or qualification regarding the opinion

aiSuggestion.description: Concatenated Phase 3 AI suggestions if present

symbolWitness.description: Manuscript witness for symbol when matn symbol was null

inUthmaniMushaf.description: True if an Uthmani mushaf pause mark occurs at this word

uthmaniMark.description: Uthmani pause symbol (صلى, قلى, ج, مـ, لا, ∴, س) or null

uthmaniMarkName.description: Arabic rule name of the Uthmani pause mark

isVerseEnd.description: True if this stop occurs at the final word of the ayah

sourceBatch.description: Batch raw filename from which this stop was projected
